sections.changelog:
### Version 0.1.210
- Fix courier detection false positive where marketplace channel names (e.g. Channel: Shopee in customer notes) were misclassified as SPX instead of chosen shipping courier (e.g. JNE)
- Prioritize authoritative shipping lines over customer notes during courier detection
- Persist explicit courier metadata (_carrier_id, _exacoat_courier) upon manual warranty and redeem claim order creation
- Add conflict guard in getOrderCourierDisplay ensuring frontend never renders misattributed courier when explicit shipping method is present
